description: Invites a person with a role on an app (project; otherwise the whole organization). For them to use an internal app: role access and project, invited and let in with one confirmation. An address in .test never receives an email. resend: true sends their pending invitation again (a new link, once an hour).

project.description: The app where the role is given; without it: the whole organization.

reason.description: The reason for the assignment (in the log); "member of the organization" by default.

resend.description: true: sends the pending invitation of this address again, without changing anything else.

role.description: On an app (project): access to use it, or reader, developer, admin. On the whole organization: developer by default; external sees only what it is granted. People who only use your internal apps: Access on the app (access and project).

name: invite_member
title: Invite a person
